CommunityApplications.Profile: Community Apps templates maintained by Aurial. Currently four apps: **Strata AMD** — a template for the official ROCm builds of [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata), which runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model on AMD Radeon GPUs (RX 7000, RX 9000, Radeon AI PRO R9700, Ryzen AI Max) in Unraid; **Radiance-LLM** — a template for [radiance](https://codeberg.org/StillDeadcode/radiance), a modular AMD inference engine serving language, image, video, speech and music models behind OpenAI-compatible APIs, one card or two; **Speech-To-Speech-CPU** — a template for [speech-to-speech](https://github.com/huggingface/speech-to-speech), Hugging Face's realtime voice-agent pipeline, running CPU-only as a self-hosted OpenAI Realtime WebSocket server; and **Phonon TTS** — a template for the official OpenAI-compatible speech server of [Phonon](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts), Gradium's open-weight on-device text-to-speech models, running CPU-only. Template and Unraid problems: open an issue in this repository. Problems with the apps themselves: the upstream links above.
